tagline: Check it. Practise against it. Protect your family.

home.sub: Paste any suspicious message and Kavach tells you if it is a scam, why, and what to do next. Then practise against a safe AI scammer so the real one never works.
home.guardian: Looking after a parent or grandparent?

check.title: Check
check.body: Paste a message or a screenshot. Get a plain-language verdict in seconds, not jargon.

drill.title: Fire Drill
drill.body: Face a safe AI scammer for a few turns. Get coached on the cues you caught and missed.

family.title: Family Loop
family.body: One tap tells someone who cares, with a summary and a call button.

home.statBody: Practising against weakened scam attempts builds resistance that reading tips alone does not.

check.title: Is this message a scam?

check.disclaimer: Kavach is advisory and can be wrong. When in doubt, contact your bank on the number printed on your card.

drill.sub: Practise against a safe AI scammer. Nothing here is real, and nothing you type is stored.
